text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock merely because it shows a gain and selling feels satisfying; decisions should reflect its future risk and return.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake; average cost is not a reason to keep it if the investment case no longer holds.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should focus on diversification and my overall portfolio rather than reacting to short-term changes."]}
